purpose: One immutable local agent result claim; no execution, stop, review or Graph completion authority
canonical_json: UTF8 compact recursively sorted typed objects; SHA256 lowercase hex
submit: Original preallocated IDs and exact canonical bytes only; local publication is pending, not guaranteed worker acceptance
presence: An existing worker-held kernel lock plus original boot/execution-deadline/hard-ceiling projection only refuses new publication; it never supplies live authority or renews a grant
ownership: Worker intake requires actual retained opaque owner/current grant and pinned directory/scope; worker ack projects fsynced native history and independently verified B1 acknowledgment
restart: No disk-to-live-authority reconstruction; no new submit without actual live owner, read-only status is historical/recovery data
